title: 🧱 Axiom Public Runtime Facade v0.2
text: Here is the result of "fetch" for the Page with URL https://app.notion.com/p/3c84c57a590c81b7a5d8d15997502eaf as of 2026-10-09T09:59:10.571Z: {"title":"Axiom Public Runtime Facade v0.2"} {"type":"emoji","emoji":"🧱"} Status: Current Public Semantic Authority. 本页取代 [Superseded] Axiom Public Runtime Facade v0.1。本次升级是 authority reconciliation，不重新设计 Product-facing Canvas semantics；主要关闭旧 Host identity 与 global Transaction terminology drift。 # 0. Review Findings / Change Summary Previous: [Superseded] Axiom Public Runtime Facade v0.1 Findings: - v0.1 把 Platform Host 等同于 Axiom SDK 内部 Axiom Host Runtime；当前 05/06 已将 architecture-level Platform Host 收敛为 Composition Root，Axiom 内部 platform integration 属于 Axiom Platform Runtime / adapter side。 - v0.1 使用 Transaction、applyTransactions、subscribeLocalTransactions 等 legacy data-plane terminology；当前 04/06/07 采用 Operation-only canonical mutation 与 Operation-based AxiomDataBridge。 - Product Shell 当前同时消费 Axiom Public Runtime Facade 与 Shared Data Runtime Public API；这不是“Product Shell 只依赖一个 Axiom SDK 就覆盖 Storage/Sync”。 Authority Basis: · · · · · 。 Non-Changes: Product Shell 仍通过粗粒度 Axiom Canvas API 控制 Canvas；不暴露 Scene/Tile/Skia/GPU/Arc internals；Pointer hot path 不经过普通 JS command/event surface；Viewport/Selection/Tool 仍属于 local/session state；Document attachment 与 persistence/sync orchestration 仍分离；Native/Web 共享同一套 product semantics。 # 1. Facade Position ```txt Product Shell ├── Axiom Public Runtime Facade │ ↓ │ Axiom Public Runtime Contract │ ↓ │ Axiom Platform Runtime / Interaction / Semantic / Scene / Render │ └── Shared Data Runtime Public API ↓ DocumentSession / Repository / LocalDurable / Sync / Blob ↕ AxiomDataBridge Axiom Semantic Core Platform Host / Composition Root ├── wires Axiom ├── wires Arc [Native] ├── binds Shared Data Runtime lifecycle/document association ports └── owns platform composition relationships ``` Public Facade 是 interactive / control / presentation plane；AxiomDataBridge 是 canonical persistence / replay / sync data plane。二者可以关联同一 process-local opaque DocumentHandle，但不得复制职责。 # 2. Public Object Model ```txt AxiomRuntime └── AxiomCanvas [0..N] ├── attached DocumentHandle [0..1] ├── CanvasState └── EventSubscription(s) ``` AxiomRuntime 是 Axiom product-facing runtime entry；AxiomCanvas 是一个可交互 Canvas view/presentation session；DocumentHandle 是 process-local opaque capability，不是 object graph pointer，不可持久化或跨 process/session。 # 3. Host / Surface Boundary Product-facing API 不暴露 HWND、ANativeWindow*、CALayer*、swapchain、SkSurface*、Arc surface descriptors。 Shell 只 mount/attach Canvas host component；physical host slot、Surface generation、canonical target、preview target 与 final composition 由 Platform Host / platform adapter、Axiom Render、Arc 各自按当前 ownership contract处理。 Surface lost / rebind 不等于 Canvas destroyed；GPU device loss 不等于 Document destroyed。 # 4. Input Hot Path Native high-frequency input 由 Arc Input acquisition / native adapter 进入 Axiom；Web 由薄 PointerEvent/coalesced adapter batch 进入 WASM/Axiom。Product Shell 的普通 command/event API 不承载逐 PointerSample hot path。 Arc Preview 是 Native optional acceleration；不可用时 Axiom Renderer 负责 inline transient preview。Product API 只暴露 pressure/tilt/input/presentation 等产品能力，不暴露 arcEnabled 之类 implementation identity。 # 5. Product-facing Command Surface Facade 表达用户意图，不表达 canonical byte protocol： - Document attachment: attachDocument / detachDocument semantics； - Tool / interaction: active tool、tool options、interaction mode、read-only； - Editor commands: undo/redo、delete/duplicate、group/ungroup、z-order、align/distribute 等 typed intent； - Viewport: pan/zoom/fit/set viewport semantics； - lifecycle / visibility: mount/visible/suspend/resume 等 coarse control。 Canonical mutation rule：Command / Intent 可生成一个或多个 Operations，但 Facade 不建立 global Transaction layer，也不能旁路修改 SemanticDocument。 # 6. Public State / Events CanvasState 只投影 UI 所需 coarse state：lifecycle/readiness、document attachment、tool、viewport、selection summary、edit capability、editing mode、runtime capability、input/presentation health。 明确不包含 SceneNode、SpatialIndex、Tile cache、raw stroke points、RenderPacket、Arc resource、GPU/Skia handles、canonical Operation bytes。 Facade events 必须 coarse / async / non-reentrant；高频 pointer、preview frame 与 local canonical Operation stream 不作为普通 Product event。local canonical Operation stream 只通过 AxiomDataBridge/Data Runtime path 发布。 # 7. Execution Stages Product API 必须区分： ```txt Command Accepted ↓ Runtime / Canonical State Applied ↓ Frame Presented ``` 普通 UI command 不默认等待 Presented；只有截图、导出、presentation synchronization 等需要显式 presentation completion 的能力才等待相应 evidence。 # 8. Data-plane Separation 当前 bridge semantic： ```txt Shared Data Runtime ↕ AxiomDataBridge Snapshot bytes OperationPacket[] applyOperations(...) subscribeLocalOperations(...) ``` external remote/replay apply 不回显为 local outbox source；batch 只是 ordered delivery / amortization，不是 Transaction。 CanonicalCommitted != LocalDurable != CloudSynced；Saved/Sync/Outbox/Cloud readiness 属于 Shared Data Runtime，不塞进 CanvasState。 # 9. Error / Capability Rule 跨 ABI/binding 不允许 C++ exception 直接泄漏；stale Canvas/Document handle、wrong lifecycle、unsupported capability、command rejected、temporary surface unavailable、internal failure 使用结构化结果。 Arc Preview loss 是 presentation degradation；Arc Input acquisition failure 是 input capability/runtime failure，二者不得混为同一 fallback。 # 10. Child Contract Rule Tool / Brush、Canvas Command & State、Selection / Property 等更细 product-facing schema 可以继续独立演进，但必须服从本页、04 Operation-only authority、06 module ownership 与 08 binding/ABI contract。任何旧子页中的 Operation/Transaction、Axiom Host Runtime = Platform Host 等表述都视为 historical terminology，不能覆盖当前 authority。 Axiom Canvas Command & State Contract v0.1 Axiom Tool & Brush Public Schema v0.1 \[Superseded\] Axiom Public Runtime Facade v0.1 Architecture Follow-up — Clipboard Interchange + Copy/Cut/Paste Contract v0.1 Pre-G5 Facade Boundary & Lifecycle Contract Closure v0.1 — P15/P16/P17
